questions: Do you have wheezing or a history of asthma/using an inhaler when this happens?
Do you have chest pain or feel like your symptoms worsen when you breathe in (pleuritic pain)?
Do you have any fever or cough (and if so, how long)?
Do you have any wheezing or a history of asthma (or have you needed an inhaler) when this happens?
Have you had any recent long travel or immobility, leg swelling/pain, or are you on estrogen-containing birth control (or pregnant) ?
Do you know your current oxygen saturation (SpO₂) and breathing rate, or have you been told you look blue/very pale?
What is your current oxygen saturation (SpO₂) from a pulse oximeter, if you have one?
Is your shortness of breath worse with exertion or when lying flat, and can you rate how severe it is from 0–10 right now?
Have you had any recent leg swelling or tenderness in one leg (e.g., pain in your calf), or are you at increased risk for blood clots?
Have you measured your current oxygen saturation (SpO₂) and heart rate on a pulse oximeter or watch?
